title: Hello, World!
narrative:
## Hello, World!

Every programming journey starts here. In XIOM, you write a `fn main()` function that returns a number. The compiler runs this function when you execute your program.

Let's write our first program that returns the number 42.

### How it works
- `fn main()` declares the main function — the entry point of your program
- `-> Int` means it returns an integer
- `return 42;` sends the value 42 back
- Every statement ends with `;`
tips: The `main` function is where your program starts
`-> Int` after the function name declares what type it returns
Every statement in XIOM ends with a semicolon
